name: EveryInfra Taobao

description_zh: 查询淘宝公开数据：商品搜索、商品详情、评价。用 EveryInfra API Key 连接，按次计费。
description_en: Query public Taobao data: product search, product details and reviews. Connect with your EveryInfra API key; pay per call.
examples_zh: 搜索淘宝上的便携咖啡机，整理价格区间和销量靠前的商品
看看这件淘宝商品的评价，总结好评和差评集中在哪些点
examples_en: Search Taobao for portable coffee makers and summarize price ranges and top sellers
Summarize the main praise and complaints in the reviews of this Taobao product
